footer_tech: Open Source OCR running in your browser. Using {ocrs} and {onnx}.
about_vulnerable: Mon (mnw) is my mother tongue. It is currently classified as a vulnerable language by UNESCO.
about_digital_presence: The biggest challenge is the lack of digital presence for Mon. This makes AI development difficult since most texts are in scanned books.
about_effort: To increase digital presence, I developed this OCR engine. It uses MobileNetV3 + BiLSTM for efficient inference.
about_inference: The engine uses ONNX Runtime Web to run locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
about_hope: MonOCR aims to bridge the gap between physical texts and digital data, enabling new educational possibilities.
docs_getting_started_desc: MonOCR Web works directly in your browser. No installation required. Upload an image or PDF to start.
docs_usage_step1: 1. Select an image or PDF file.
docs_usage_step2: 2. Wait for the model to download (once).
docs_privacy_desc: All processing happens on your machine. No files are uploaded to the internet.
main_hero: Mon OCR Project for preserving Mon language in the digital age.
main_requirements: Requirements: Modern browser with hardware acceleration and 4GB+ RAM.
main_model_info: Model file (46.2MB) is downloaded once and works offline.
main_loading_model: Loading model from Hugging Face... (Please wait)
error_file_type: Invalid file type. Use JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF.
footer_tagline: A production-grade OCR system for Mon language preservation.
modal_confirm_delete_msg: Are you sure you want to clear all history? This action cannot be undone.
action_helper_image_pdf: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP and PDF
docs_hero_desc: High-performance, private, and localized optical character recognition framework optimized for archival language preservation.
docs_install_desc: Deploy the engine using our official package manager. We recommend virtual environments for research isolation.
docs_impl_desc: Initialize the engine and run an inference pass on a local manuscript image.
docs_standards_desc: Optimization parameters for maximum character recognition accuracy.
docs_standards_dpi_desc: 300 DPI baseline. 600 DPI recommended for ancient archives.
docs_standards_light_desc: Diffuse lighting required. Minimize specular reflections.
docs_sdks_desc: Cross-platform integration libraries for academic research.
docs_privacy_guarantee: Local recognition guarantee. Data integrity is maintained on-device. No manuscript information ever leaves your environment.
docs_license_desc: Open-source governance for research and preservation project. You are free to use and modify the engine for any purpose.
